findings.source_quote: οἱ οὖν μετανοοῦντες ἀποβάλλετε τὰς πονηρίας τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου τὰς ἐκτριβούσας ὑμᾶς
findings.english_quote: So, you who are turning away from your sins, throw off the evils of this age that wear you down.
findings.issue: The simplified edition changes the repeated repentance term μετανοοῦντες to an explanatory expression, while rendering μετανοεῖν and μετάνοια as “repent” and “repentance” immediately beforehand. The explanation is contextually plausible, but the supplied metadata does not document this particular exception or explain why the source's repeated terminology is not retained. The general repentance note does not identify this local change.
findings.suggested_revision: Consider “So, you who are repenting, throw off the evils of this age that wear you down.” Alternatively, document the specific contextual rationale for this explanatory rendering and its departure from the repeated repentance terminology. Any replacement requires fresh review.

findings.english_quote: I have told you these things.
findings.issue: The simplified edition silently omits the selected source's bracketed πάντα. Because the word is presented as an editorial supplement, this is not an omission of preserved text; nevertheless, neither the reader text nor the notes disclose the decision to exclude the supplied supplement. The standard edition retains its bracketed status.
findings.suggested_revision: Add a brief source note stating that the selected working source includes bracketed “all” and that this edition omits that editorial supplement. Alternatively, retain a clearly marked equivalent with an explanation of its editorial status; do not present it as unbracketed preserved text.

summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all clauses of the supplied normalized Greek. The standard edition preserves the passage's assertions, conditions, negations, speakers, and bracketed supplement and is accepted within this review's scope. The simplified edition preserves the substantive content but needs clearer documentation of its local repentance-term variation and omission of the editorial supplement. This assessment does not authenticate the named historical edition, unseen manuscripts, or the linked project records.
